title: [WT-10G] Wrappers: sparse frozen-gate workspaces exclude .moe
description:
Objective: provide the .moe-free frozen-gate interface required by revised WT-S §2.2 L6 without changing shared-checkout gates. SPIDR Interface prerequisite extracted from WT-10 after its QA-driven contract expansion.
Deliverable: an explicit optional worktree-mode arm on existing run_frozen_gate (argument `worktree`; default shared) / Invoke-MoeFrozenGate (-WorktreeMode switch; absent preserves shared), plus gate_integrity_wt / Test-MoeGateIntegrityWorktree. Use worktree add --detach --no-checkout at the frozen commit, sparse-checkout set --no-cone '/*' '!/.moe/', then read-tree -mu HEAD, never core.sparseCheckout=false in this arm. Retain HEAD/write-tree/diff-files checks; clear skip-worktree/assume-unchanged only for paths outside .moe. A .moe directory/file/link before or after the gate is MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY and failure. Existing child supervision, evidence recording and owned cleanup remain in use. Add mirrored regression cases in scripts/tests/postflight.sh and postflight.ps1. Four edited files: the wrappers and these harnesses; no held-out worktree-landing test edits.
NOT in scope: land lease, round limits, migration flags, publication protocol, daemon/proxy changes, resource settings or documentation sweep. WT-10 consumes this callable interface after it lands.
Verification from repo root: node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh; on native Windows additionally node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell. Exact same source revision on both engines, no unavailable-engine pass. Shared-mode cases remain unchanged.
definitionOfDone: The worktree-mode gate command sees the exact frozen HEAD/tree and MOE_PROJECT_PATH pointing to its disposable root, with .moe absent despite tracked .moe records; both postflight harnesses prove it.
A gate that creates .moe/x, a file named .moe, or a dangling .moe link fails with MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY; cleanup touches only owned scratch paths and source/control sentinels remain unchanged.
Tracked source mutations, including index flag hiding outside .moe, still fail integrity; excluded .moe index entries remain skip-worktree and do not materialize.
Existing shared-mode frozen-gate behavior and error handling pass unchanged; default calls still select shared behavior.
The named verification exits 0, native Windows PS5.1 postflight passes on the same revision, and both wrappers carry the same introduced MOE_WORKTREE_ codes.

implementationPlan.description:
1. TESTS FIRST (red), both harnesses. Load test-driven-development. Build on the landed bytes of WT-09 (task-0921d6d7) and CQ-V04c (task-c4e076cd); never revert a peer hunk; never edit the held-out suites (postflight-worktree.cjs, worktree-landing.*).

The worktree arm is not wired into landing until WT-10, so these cases call it directly, function-level, from the existing frozen-candidate node suite. That suite is embedded byte-identically in postflight.sh (heredoc FROZENJS) and postflight.ps1 (the here-string written to $frozenSuite): make every edit in both copies, identically. Inside it no line may start with '@ (that ends the PS here-string) or be exactly FROZENJS, and driver text inside JS template literals carries no backticks and no ${ (write \t and \n where bash must see \t and \n; PS uses [char]9 / [char]10).

a. modes: append 'wt-pass','wt-default','wt-moe-dir','wt-moe-file','wt-moe-link','wt-moe-link-out','wt-before','wt-tracked','wt-hidden','wt-nested'. No platform gate: both engines run all ten.
b. In the loop, right after the integrity-batch block: if(mode.startsWith('wt-')){wtGate(mode);count++;continue;}
c. Above `let count=0;` define:
- WT_GATE, the fixture's tracked gate.cjs. First it writes JSON to process.env.WTG_OBS: dirs = [process.cwd(), process.env.MOE_PROJECT_PATH, `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`], each through fs.realpathSync.native; parent = realpath('..'); head = `git rev-parse HEAD`; tree = `git write-tree`; moe = whether fs.lstatSync('.moe') succeeds; flags = `git ls-files -t -- .moe`. Then by WTG_MODE: wt-moe-dir mkdir .moe and write .moe/x; wt-moe-file writes a file .moe; wt-moe-link makes a dangling link .moe -> path.resolve('..','missing-target'); wt-moe-link-out makes a link .moe -> process.env.WTG_CONTROL_MOE (the control checkout's .moe). Links use fs.symlinkSync(target,'.moe',process.platform==='win32'?'junction':'dir') (a junction needs no privilege and may dangle; verified). wt-tracked rewrites tracked src.txt; wt-hidden runs update-index --skip-worktree src.txt and --assume-unchanged gate.cjs, then rewrites src.txt and appends to gate.cjs. Every mode exits 0.
- shFunctions(): from the wrapper text, for each of gate_git, gate_integrity, gate_integrity_wt, stop_gate_child, remove_gate_root, cleanup_gate_workspace, freeze_candidate, run_frozen_gate: i = s.indexOf('\n'+name+'() {'); assert.ok(i>=0,'moe-agent.sh has no '+name); take s.slice(i+1, s.indexOf('\n}\n',i)+3). Name-based slicing survives function moves. If CQ-V04c's run_frozen_gate calls another wrapper helper, add its name.
- WT_SH (bash driver): set -e; the sliced functions; stubs record_candidate_rpc() { return 0; } and record_check_run_rpc() { printf '%s\t%s\n' "$GATE_RC" "$GATE_OUTCOME" >> "$WTG_CHECKS"; }; GREEN= BLUE= NC= YELLOW= GATE_PENDING_ROOTS= GATE_OUTCOME=; PYTHON_CMD=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); MOE_TOP=$WTG_REPO; MOE_REL=$WTG_REL; QUALITY_GATE='node gate.cjs'; freeze_candidate "$WTG_BASE" "$WTG_TREE"; if run_frozen_gate $WTG_ARM; then rc=0; else rc=1; fi; flags=$(git -C "$GATE_WORKSPACE" ls-files -t -- .moe src.txt) only while that dir still exists; if cleanup_gate_workspace; then clean=0; else clean=1; fi; printf rc=, clean=, commit=$FROZEN_COMMIT and flags= (flags last) into $WTG_RESULT.
- WT_PS1 (PS driver; ASCII only, because PS 5.1 reads a BOM-less file as ANSI; mem:pattern-ps1-function-probe-via-ast): $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; ParseFile($env:WTG_WRAPPER) and throw on parse errors; dot-source every top-level FunctionDefinitionAst, then every top-level AssignmentStatementAst whose Left extent text is -like '$script:MoeGate*' (gate type source, type name, pending list); then define Send-MoeCheckRun([hashtable]$Frozen,[hashtable]$Gate) that appends [string]$Gate.ExitCode + [char]9 + [string]$Gate.Outcome + [char]10 to $env:WTG_CHECKS and returns $true; $git=@{Top=$env:WTG_REPO;Rel=$env:WTG_REL}; $frozen=New-MoeFrozenCandidate $git $env:WTG_TREE $env:WTG_BASE; $ok = the last element of @(Invoke-MoeFrozenGate $git $frozen 'node gate.cjs'), plus -WorktreeMode when $env:WTG_ARM is set; flags from Invoke-MoeGit ls-files -t -- .moe src.txt while $script:MoeGate.Workspace exists; $clean=Remove-MoeGateWorkspace; write the same four keys joined by [char]10.
- wtGate(mode): a fresh repo root/<mode> (core.autocrlf false, user.name, user.email) with tracked .moe/tasks/task-a.json, .moe/project.json, src.txt and gate.cjs. For wt-before the tracked .moe is a FILE instead: the '!/.moe/' pattern only excludes directories, so it materializes (the before-command case). Commit, then write an untracked control sentinel .moe/daemon.json (not for wt-before). snap() = [HEAD, ls-files -s, git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain -uall, the exit status of config --get core.sparseCheckout, an lstat-based recursive map of the control's .moe (link -> 'link:'+readlink, file -> bytes)]. Env: process.env without any GIT_* name; HOME and USERPROFILE under root; TMPDIR, TMP and TEMP = root/<mode>-tmp (owned scratch: sh mktemp -t and ps1 GetTempPath both create gate roots there, and Remove-MoeGateRoot's owned-path check passes); WTG_WRAPPER, WTG_REPO, WTG_BASE=HEAD, WTG_TREE=HEAD^{tree}, WTG_MODE, WTG_OBS/WTG_CHECKS/WTG_RESULT under root, WTG_CONTROL_MOE; WTG_ARM='worktree' except wt-default (unset: the default call); WTG_REL='sub' only for wt-nested. Write the driver once per run; spawn engine with [driver] (sh) or ['-NoProfile','-File',driver] (ps1), encoding utf8, timeout 120000, windowsHide; assert status 0 with stdout+stderr as the message.
d. Exact assertions (log = stdout+stderr):
- every mode: clean '0'; root/<mode>-tmp is empty; `worktree list --porcelain` lists only the control; snap() deepEquals the pre-run snapshot.
- whenever obs exists: its three dirs are one path whose basename is 'tree' and whose dirname is obs.parent; dirname(obs.parent) equals realpathSync.native(<mode>-tmp); obs.parent no longer exists; [obs.head, obs.tree] equal [result commit, HEAD^{tree}].
- wt-pass: rc '0', checks ['0\tpassed'], no MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY, obs.moe false, obs.flags 'S .moe/project.json\nS .moe/tasks/task-a.json'.
- wt-default: rc '0', checks ['0\tpassed'], obs.moe true, obs.flags 'H .moe/project.json\nH .moe/tasks/task-a.json' (today's full checkout: the default call still selects shared).
- wt-moe-dir, wt-moe-file, wt-moe-link, wt-moe-link-out: rc '1', MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY in log, checks ['0\tinconclusive'], obs.moe false, result flags 'S .moe/project.json\nS .moe/tasks/task-a.json\nH src.txt'.
- wt-tracked, wt-hidden: rc '1', checks ['0\tinconclusive'], no MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY, result flags as above (wt-hidden: the post-gate check cleared src.txt's bit and kept the .moe bits).
- wt-before: rc '1', MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY in log, no check rows, no obs. wt-nested: rc '1', MOE_WORKTREE_PROJECT_NOT_TOP in log, no MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY, no check rows, no obs.
Outcome names follow CQ-V04c's plan (GATE_OUTCOME / $Gate.Outcome); use the landed names if they differ.
e. Red proof on a snapshot (mem:pattern-wrapper-harness-snapshot-verify-from-wsl) with MOE_FROZEN_TEST_ONLY set to the ten modes, both engines: sh fails 'moe-agent.sh has no gate_integrity_wt'; ps1 fails on the unknown -WorktreeMode parameter; wt-default already passes on both. implementationPlan.description:
2. scripts/moe-agent.sh: the worktree arm, built on CQ-V04c's landed run_frozen_gate (its outcome classification stays the one place that decides passed, inconclusive or code-failure). Running seats read this file: save through a same-filesystem scratch copy, `bash -n`, then `mv -f`.
a. gate_integrity: `gate_git ls-files -z |` becomes `gate_git ls-files -z "$@" |`. With no argument (every shared call) the command is byte-for-byte today's.
b. New gate_integrity_wt directly after it, with a two-line comment citing WT-S §2.2 L6:
   if [ -e "$GATE_WORKSPACE/.moe" ] || [ -L "$GATE_WORKSPACE/.moe" ]; then
       echo "[WARN] MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY: the qualityGate worktree holds .moe; refusing branch commit." >&2; return 1
   fi
   gate_integrity -- ':(top,exclude).moe'
   -L is needed because -e is false for a dangling link. The exclude pathspec keeps the sparse skip-worktree bits of .moe/ entries and clears every other entry's bits, so diff-files still catches hidden source mutations. A gate-made .moe directory is untracked and passes diff-files (verified), so only the presence check catches it.
c. run_frozen_gate [worktree], with a comment: no argument = today's full shared checkout (rail 4); `worktree` = the .moe-free arm WT-10 calls.
   - local integrity=gate_integrity. After the existing no-gate `return 0`, when "${1:-}" = worktree: integrity=gate_integrity_wt, and a non-empty "${MOE_REL:-}" prints "[WARN] MOE_WORKTREE_PROJECT_NOT_TOP: a worktree-mode qualityGate needs the project at the repository top; refusing branch commit." to stderr and returns 1 before any cleanup or mktemp (a nested project's <rel>/.moe is outside '!/.moe/'; WT-04 already stops such seats, this is defense in depth).
   - Materialization in the arm, one brace group redirected to "$GATE_LOG": git -C "$MOE_TOP" -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null worktree add --detach --no-checkout "$GATE_WORKSPACE" "$FROZEN_COMMIT" && gate_git sparse-checkout set --no-cone '/*' '!/.moe/' && gate_git read-tree -mu HEAD. Never core.sparseCheckout=false here. A failure prints the existing "[WARN] qualityGate workspace materialization failed." and returns 1; the root stays owned for the next cleanup point; no fallback to a full checkout. The shared arm keeps today's exact worktree add line.
   - Every gate_integrity call inside run_frozen_gate (the initial check and CQ-V04c's post-gate classification) becomes "$integrity". Check id, child supervision, recording, refusal order, [WARN] wording, the [OK] line and cleanup stay unchanged.
d. remove_gate_root: first line `if [ -L "$1/tree/.moe" ]; then rm -f -- "$1/tree/.moe" || return 1; fi`, commented: a gate-made .moe link is unlinked, never followed (WT-S §1.10); a failure keeps the root pending for the next cleanup point. In shared mode .moe is a real tracked directory or absent, so it never fires there.
Error handling: every new path fails closed (return 1 is a refusal the landing already turns into MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE plus a rescue ref); nothing new can reach 'passed' without exit 0 and the selected integrity check.
Verified with git 2.43 at planning: --no-checkout + sparse-checkout set + read-tree -mu HEAD materializes everything but .moe/, whose entries carry S bits; HEAD and write-tree equal the frozen pair; the control's core.sparseCheckout stays unset (extensions.worktreeConfig=true is written once to the common config, as WT-04 already does); a tracked FILE named .moe does materialize; `sparse-checkout disable` re-materializes .moe; `worktree remove --force` drops a .moe symlink without following it.
Run the ten wt-* modes on sh until green, then every frozen mode on sh.
implementationPlan.note:
Reopen-1 fix, QA issue 1, at moe-agent.sh:5320-5326 in run_frozen_gate's worktree arm only (+5/-2, Edit tool, bash -n OK, LF, mode 100755).

Change: the sparse patterns now go to git on stdin: `printf '%s\n' '/*' '!/.moe/' | gate_git sparse-checkout set --no-cone --stdin`. Before, they were argv. Stdin is never MSYS-converted, so this needs no MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL. The '*' form would break the POSIX mktemp -C path (rc 128), and '!/' relies on MSYS's glob-skip rule for '/*'. A 3-line comment, like the one at :3117, says why.
- Patterns, the order worktree add -> sparse set -> read-tree -mu HEAD, the fail-closed materialization refusal and no core.sparseCheckout=false are unchanged. The shared arm is untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
3. scripts/moe-agent.ps1: the exact twin of step 2, same sentences and codes. Keep UTF-8 with BOM and LF endings; parse with [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile under Windows PowerShell 5.1 before testing.
a. Test-MoeGateIntegrity([hashtable]$Frozen,[string]$Exclude='') passes $Exclude to Clear-MoeGateIndexFlags([string]$Top,[string]$Exclude=''). Its cmd line stays exactly 'git ls-files -z | git update-index --no-assume-unchanged --no-skip-worktree -z --stdin' when $Exclude is empty, and becomes 'git ls-files -z -- ":(top,exclude).moe" | git update-index --no-assume-unchanged --no-skip-worktree -z --stdin' otherwise. Verified on PS 5.1 at planning: the quoted pathspec survives `cmd /d /s /c` and keeps the .moe/ S bits. Keep the single --stdin pipe and no foreach/ForEach-Object anywhere between `function Test-MoeGateIntegrity` and `function Stop-MoeGateChild`: the integrity-batch mode slices that span.
b. New Test-MoeGateIntegrityWorktree([hashtable]$Frozen) after Clear-MoeGateIndexFlags: when $null -ne (Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:MoeGate.Workspace '.moe') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) (WT-04's idiom; verified it sees a dangling junction), Write-Host the same MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY sentence as sh (Yellow) and return $false; otherwise return (Test-MoeGateIntegrity $Frozen ':(top,exclude).moe').
c. Invoke-MoeFrozenGate([hashtable]$Git,[hashtable]$Frozen,[string]$Command,[switch]$WorktreeMode). Existing positional calls stay shared.
   - After `if (-not $Command) { return $true }`: when $WorktreeMode -and $Git.Rel, Write-Host the same MOE_WORKTREE_PROJECT_NOT_TOP sentence as sh (Yellow) and return $false, before Remove-MoeGateWorkspace or any directory.
   - $integrity = 'Test-MoeGateIntegrityWorktree' when $WorktreeMode, else 'Test-MoeGateIntegrity'. Call (& $integrity $Frozen) for the initial check and inside CQ-V04c's outcome classification; a throw there still becomes 'inconclusive'.
   - Materialization in the arm: Invoke-MoeGit -Top $Git.Top -GitArgs @('-c','core.hooksPath=NUL','worktree','add','--detach','--no-checkout',$gate.Workspace,$Frozen.Commit), then -Top $gate.Workspace @('sparse-checkout','set','--no-cone','/*','!/.moe/'), then @('read-tree','-mu','HEAD'), each only when the previous Rc is 0. A nonzero Rc throws the existing 'qualityGate workspace materialization failed'. Verified on PS 5.1: '/*' reaches git.exe unexpanded. The shared arm keeps today's call.
d. Remove-MoeGateRoot: after the owned-path validation and before `worktree remove`: $moe = Join-Path $Entry.Workspace '.moe'; $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $moe -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; when $item has [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint, [IO.Directory]::Delete($moe) for a container (a junction or directory link: RemoveDirectory removes the link itself; verified on a dangling junction) else [IO.File]::Delete($moe). A throw propagates, so Remove-MoeGateWorkspace keeps the entry and retries. Probe on this host: Git for Windows' `worktree remove --force` exited 0 but left a .moe junction and tree\ behind without following it; unlinking first makes the removal complete and never reaches the link target (§1.10).
Error handling as in sh: every new path returns $false or throws into the existing catch; nothing new can produce 'passed'.
Run the ten wt-* modes under PS 5.1 from WSL until green, then every frozen mode.
